say:1:1530124701:1.text: Death is everywhere. Even without the flood, Halians would still die anyway.
say:1:1530124701:1.source_cn: 哪里都有死亡，就算没有洪水，呼临人也会死。
say:1:1530124701:1.male: Death is everywhere. Even without the flood, Halians would still die anyway.
say:1:1530124701:1.female: Death is everywhere. Even without the flood, Halians would still die anyway.

say:2:1530124702:1.text: If not for them, my child would still have a father.
say:2:1530124702:1.source_cn: 要不是他们，我孩子的阿爹也不会在战场上丢了命。
say:2:1530124702:1.male: If not for them, my child would still have a father.
say:2:1530124702:1.female: If not for them, my child would still have a father.

say:3:1530124703:1.text: The flood upon Halia is nothing but justice!
say:3:1530124703:1.source_cn: 呼临人遭受洪水，是他们的报应！
say:3:1530124703:1.male: The flood upon Halia is nothing but justice!
say:3:1530124703:1.female: The flood upon Halia is nothing but justice!
